meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
Choosing the right face wash for oily skin helps control excess shine, clear clogged pores, and prevent breakouts without stripping your skin of essential moisture.[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=When%20your%20skin%20is%20concerned%20with%20excess,excessive%20dryness%20or%20stretchy%20feel%20post%20cleansing.) Several top-rated options available in India are priced well under ₹500.

### For Deep Pore Cleansing & Acne Control

The Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash uses **antioxidant-rich green tea** and **glycolic acid** to gently exfoliate, clear out sebum, and manage acne.

The The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne with 2% Salicylic Acid Niacinamide Face Wash combines **2% salicylic acid** and **niacinamide** to regulate oil production and combat blemishes.

The Foxtale Oil & Acne Control Face Wash | 2% Salicylic Acid + Niacinamide + Cica + Hyaluronic Acid | Fights Acne, Controls Oil & Soothes Skin|For Oily, features **cica and hyaluronic acid** alongside salicylic acid to purify pores while preventing a tight, dry feeling.

### For Gentle & Budget-Friendly Care

The Himalaya Neem Purifying Face Wash relies on **natural neem and turmeric** to clear impurities, making it a classic, budget-friendly pick for everyday use.

The Dot & Key Watermelon Super Glow Vitamin C Face Wash Gel offers a **sulfate-free gel formula** infused with cooling cucumber and vitamin C to refresh dull, oily skin.

### Summary Recommendation

* Choose **Plum Green Tea** if you prefer gentle chemical exfoliation with glycolic acid.[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=The%20green%20tea%20formulation%20which%20is%20rich,texture.%20What%20Makes%20It%20a%20Good%20Choice%3F)
* Choose **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide** or **Foxtale** if your oily skin is actively prone to acne and breakouts.
* Choose **Himalaya Neem** for a trusted herbal, low-cost daily cleanser.

If you would like, I can suggest a lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturizer to pair with your face wash to keep your skin balanced throughout the day. Do you want me to do that?
